name: metrologybase
description: MetrologyBase — practical tools, resources, and vendor-neutral buying guidance for calibration professionals.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/pressure-gauges && cp index.html articles.html products.html pressure-gauges.html full-scale-vs-full-span.html pressure-adapters-and-fittings.html what-pressure-fittings-for-10000-psi.html what-pressure-fittings-for-60000-psi.html styles.css app.js dist/ && cp pressure-gauges/*.html pressure-gauges/device.css pressure-gauges/device.js dist/pressure-gauges/ && cp -R public/. dist/
